newsitem.title: UK: Motown best records to make love to-UK youngsters.
newsitem.headline: Motown best records to make love to-UK youngsters.

text.p: Motown hits from the Seventies are the best music to make love to, young Britons said on Thursday.
Gallup, which polled 1,000 youngsters aged between 18 and 24, found that veteran crooners Tom Jones and David Essex were also considered more hip than modern bands Oasis and Take That.
"Magic Motown moments are the best records to make love to," Gallup said.
Among modern singers, American Jon Bon Jovi and Britain's Louise topped the poll as the sexiest performers.
